US_INDPRO_history_value.method: First-release monthly growth reconstructed from initial current-month index and first revised prior-month index using 100 * (init[t] / rev1[t-1] - 1).
US_INDPRO_history_value.note: Current revised history can change the sign of a historical monthly move; only first-release values are eligible for PIT backtests.
